verdict.rationale: Graphite ships an official `gt` CLI, installable via Homebrew or npm, fully git-compatible, with a command reference and configuration docs. Community users corroborate daily CLI use, such as rebasing multiple branches at once, and GT MCP extends the CLI workflow so AI agents can create stacked PRs. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable or non-interactive output modes aimed at agent-driven CLI use (`gt config` is described as an interactive menu).
